name: TMOS mise radar
author: Chyld Medford (TMOS fork by Timothy DeFreest)
description: Watches the mise-managed AI CLIs you actually use and turns the bar red when one falls behind latest, with one-click upgrades per tool or for everything. Optionally watches any number of remote Docker stacks you name, showing image updates with security and breaking-change flags.

barWidget.description: See which mise tools are behind latest and upgrade them from the panel.
